lines.intro: A fizzy crab scuttles out from the rocks, claws snap-snapping!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the crab?

soothe.great: Fae hums a slow wave song. The crab's claws settle, drifting like the tide!
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. The crab sways side to side with the music.
soothe.miss: The crab clacks right over Fae's humming.

play.great: Maddie skitters sideways, and the crab copies her! Scuttle, scuttle!
play.good: Maddie wiggles her tail. The crab taps a claw on the sand.
play.miss: Maddie pounces at the crab's shadow. The crab snaps the air.

cast.great: Sue casts her ribbon bobber past the rocks. The crab scoots after the ripples!
cast.good: Sue's bobber bobs in the foam. The crab's eyestalks follow it.
cast.miss: Sue's bobber plops in the sand. The crab buries itself up to its eyes.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three pebbles. The crab catches one in each claw, so proud!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pebble high. The crab reaches up. Click!
juggle.miss: Jordan's pebble bonks the sand. The crab snips it, unimpressed.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy snack. The crab munches it with tiny clicks!
lines.burst: The crab spins in a fizzy bubble storm, claws everywhere!

burstResult.good: Fae dodges most of the sea spray!
burstResult.miss: SPLASH! Fae gets a face full of fizzy foam.

lines.soothed: The crab lets out a bubbly sigh. The fizz melts back into the tide!
lines.rest: Fae is all sandy and tired. Time for a rest.
lines.run: Fae tiptoes up the beach. The crab clicks at the waves.
